## Ideal customer profile

| Dimension | Fit | Disqualifier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Business model | Direct-to-consumer or marketplace brand selling online | B2B catalogue with offline ordering |
| Size | Mid-market: a growth team of two or more, no analytics engineer | Enterprise with a central analytics platform team |
| Stack | Modern storefront platform plus a cloud warehouse | Custom storefront with no event stream |
| Trigger | New Head of Growth; analytics ticket backlog; a migration to a new storefront | Active enterprise-suite contract with more than a year left |

## Personas

| Persona | Goal | Pain | Typical objection |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Head of Growth (buyer) | Faster experiment read-outs; one definition of conversion | Every question is a data ticket | "We already have dashboards" |
| Merchandising lead (champion) | Know which collections and promotions move the funnel | Tools speak in events, not merchandising | "I am not technical" |
| Head of Data (influencer) | Fewer ad-hoc requests; schema that does not rot | Owning custom event taxonomies | "We can build this" |
